messages.author: 33b6339deaf791d2
messages.subject: Error Installing Deducer
parts:
Hi,
I just downloaded and installed R 2.10.0 on my Windows XP-Laptop. When
trying to install Deducer by typing install.packages(c
("rJava","JGR","Deducer")) I get the following Error-Message:
Fehler: Paket 'rJava' 0.7-0 gefunden, aber >= 0.8 wird von 'JGR'
benötigt

Seems that there is for Windows only 0.7. Where can I get 0.8 for
Windows?
Any Idea what I can do?
Thanx for your help
Roland

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Error Installing Deducer
parts:
Roland,

The transition to 2.10.0 and JGR 1.7 should be finished soon. in the
mean time, you can use:
install.packages(c("rJava","JGR","Deducer"),,"http://www.rforge.net",type="source")

you will need to have the tools for building packages from source
installed. these can be gotten at:
http://www.murdoch-sutherland.com/Rtools/

Ian
